name: Tutoring
author: GlossX
description: Teach a concept from the selected papers, slides or notes: gather the passages that define and use it, then explain step by step with a worked example and a short cited quiz.

capability.card: Teach or explain a concept from the papers to a learner: intuition, precise definition, worked example, misconceptions and a short quiz, all cited.

args.instructions: Write for a student meeting this topic for the first time. Order: (1) the intuition in two or three sentences, (2) the precise idea in the paper's own notation, (3) a small worked example, (4) common misconceptions, (5) 'Check your understanding': three questions, each followed by a hint and then the answer with a citation. Keep every factual statement cited.
